says: Pull request 1012's portable cut, which T502 S1 copied byte for byte, drops the name of the function that called eval from a stored frame and leaves a stray parenthesis, cuts a frame name that holds a slash, and keeps only the tail of a location whose query string holds a slash; 1012's law S2 expects the eval loss, so it passes on a case 0186 rules out.
proof: The T502 S1 review ran a copy of portable on real Node output: 'at eval (eval at outerFn (file:///x/portable.mjs:13:27), <anonymous>:3:7)' is stored as 'at eval (portable.mjs:13:27), <anonymous>:3:7)'; 'at a/b (/x/y/z.ts:1:2)' is stored as 'at b (z.ts:1:2)'; 'at fn (http://localhost:5173/src/a.ts?t=/x/y:1:2)' is stored as 'at fn (y:1:2)'. Sink.test.ts in 1012 has the eval shape's expected text as 'at eval (${file}), <anonymous>:1:1)'.
cost: Whichever of 1012 and T502 S1 lands second meets a conflict in Sink.ts and Sink.test.ts, and if 1012 lands as it is, stored errors lose the eval origin's name for good.
